segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ אֵין מְבִיאִין לֹא מִבֵּית הַזְּבָלִים, וְלֹא מִבֵּית הַשְּׁלָחִים, וְלֹא מִבֵּית הָאִילָן, וְאִם הֵבִיא – כָּשֵׁר.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» Even when selecting grain for meal offerings from the locations mentioned in the previous mishna, «one may not bring» as a meal offering grain «from a fertilized field, nor from an irrigated field, nor from a field of trees,» as such fields do not produce grain of optimal quality. «But if» one «did bring» a meal offering of grain from such fields, it is «fit.»

segments.he: כֵּיצַד הוּא עוֹשֶׂה? נָרָהּ שָׁנָה רִאשׁוֹנָה, וּבְשָׁנָה שְׁנִיָּה זוֹרְעָהּ קוֹדֶם לַפֶּסַח שִׁבְעִים יוֹם, וְהִוא עוֹשָׂה סוֹלֶת מְרוּבָּה.
segments.en: «How does one produce» optimal-quality grain? «He plows» the field during the «first year,» but he does not sow it, «and in the second year, he sows it seventy days before Passover, and» in that manner «it produces» grain that will provide «an abundance of fine,» high-quality, «flour.»

segments.he: כֵּיצַד בּוֹדֵק הַגִּזְבָּר? מַכְנִיס יָדוֹ לְתוֹכָהּ. עָלָה בָּהּ אָבָק – פְּסוּלָה, עַד שֶׁיְּנַפֶּנָּה.
segments.en: «How does» the Temple treasurer «inspect» the flour to determine whether it is of sufficiently high quality? «The treasurer inserts his hand into» the flour. If, when he removes his hand, flour «powder covers it,» the flour is «unfit, until one sifts it» with a fine sifter, so that no powder will remain.
«And if» the flour «became wormy,» it is «unfit» for use in a meal offering.

moves.summary: grain may not ab initio come from fertilized, irrigated or tree fields; valid after the fact
how optimal grain is produced: plow year one, sow year two seventy days before Passover
the treasurer tests flour with his hand; powder means unfit until sifted

positions.claim: one may not bring grain from fertilized, irrigated or tree-planted fields, but if brought it is fit
optimal grain: plow in year one, sow seventy days before Passover in year two
flour that leaves powder on the treasurer's hand is unfit until sifted; wormy flour is unfit
